project.name: enphase-monitor
project.description: A Go CLI application that monitors and aggregates data from one or more Enphase solar Systems at a Site via the Enphase Enlighten Cloud API v4, supporting OAuth authentication, response caching, multi-system metric aggregation (production, consumption, batteries, grid import/export, net flow), and True-Up Period reporting.

nodes.name: .golangci.yml
nodes.summary: GolangCI-Lint configuration enabling a curated set of linters (errcheck, govet, staticcheck, etc.) with gocognit complexity threshold and a default run timeout, ensuring code quality gates in CI.

nodes.name: Makefile
nodes.summary: Build automation defining 14 targets including build, run, run-once, install, setup, test, test-coverage, lint, and help — the primary developer workflow entry point for the project.

nodes.name: go.mod
nodes.summary: Go module definition declaring the module path and minimum Go version with a single external dependency (gopkg.in/yaml.v3 for config parsing).

nodes.name: go.sum
nodes.summary: Go module checksum file recording cryptographic hashes for the yaml.v3 dependency to ensure reproducible builds.

nodes.name: testmain_test.go
nodes.summary: TestMain setup for the api package tests, configuring the cache in test mode before running the test suite.

nodes.name: trueup_test.go
nodes.summary: Unit tests for True-Up logic covering window-end boundary conditions, TrueUpReport field mapping, net flow calculations, and per-system metric conversion.

nodes.name: cli.go
nodes.summary: Provides CLI-facing cache management operations: clearing today's or all cached entries, listing cache contents with formatted output, and parsing cached API response bodies for display.

nodes.name: CacheEntry
nodes.summary: Data structure representing a single cache entry for CLI listing, holding the cache key, endpoint, system ID, queried date, cache timestamp, and file size.

nodes.name: ClearTodayCache
nodes.summary: Deletes all cached files whose QueriedDate matches today's date in the report timezone, printing a summary of deleted and kept entries.

nodes.name: ListCacheEntries
nodes.summary: Scans the cache directory and returns a sorted slice of CacheEntry structs describing each cached response, suitable for CLI listing.

nodes.name: parseCacheResponse
nodes.summary: Parses raw JSON from a cached Enphase API response body (telemetry or production/consumption meter format) and formats the interval data as human-readable text for the CLI.

nodes.name: cli_test.go
nodes.summary: Comprehensive tests for cache CLI operations covering ClearTodayCache, ClearAllCache, ListCacheEntries, LoadCachedResponseByPath, and parseCacheResponse with various telemetry formats and edge cases.

nodes.name: cache_commands.go
nodes.summary: Thin CLI command handlers that delegate cache clear and list operations to the cache package, bridging the cobra/flag layer to cache management logic.

nodes.name: HandleClearCache
nodes.summary: Invokes ClearTodayCache on the cache package to remove today's cached entries and prints the result to stdout.

nodes.name: cache_commands_test.go
nodes.summary: Tests for CLI cache command handlers verifying that HandleClearCache and HandleClearAllCache behave correctly under different cache states.

nodes.name: oauth.go
nodes.summary: Implements the Enphase OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow: generates the authorization URL, exchanges the code for tokens, and manages token refresh and persistent on-disk token caching.

nodes.name: OAuthTokenResponse
nodes.summary: JSON-deserialization target for Enphase OAuth token endpoint responses, holding access token, refresh token, expiry, and token type.

nodes.name: TokenCache
nodes.summary: On-disk token cache structure storing the access token, refresh token, and expiry time to avoid repeated OAuth round-trips.

nodes.name: GetAccessToken
nodes.summary: Retrieves a valid OAuth 2.0 access token: loads from disk cache if present and unexpired, automatically refreshes via the refresh token flow if expired, or exits with user instructions if no cached token exists.

nodes.name: ExchangeAuthorizationCode
nodes.summary: Exchanges an OAuth authorization code for access and refresh tokens, persisting the result to the on-disk token cache for subsequent requests.

nodes.name: oauth_edge_cases_test.go
nodes.summary: Edge-case tests for the OAuth package covering expired tokens, invalid JSON in token cache, HTTP error responses, missing refresh tokens, and boundary conditions in the authorization flow.

nodes.name: oauth_test.go
nodes.summary: Unit tests for GetAuthorizationURL construction and basic OAuth configuration validation against the expected Enphase OAuth endpoint format.

nodes.name: setup.go
nodes.summary: Implements the interactive OAuth 2.0 setup wizard for the Enphase Enlighten API, guiding the user through browser-based authorization, authorization code entry, token exchange, and credentials display.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses bufio.NewReader for stdin prompts and os/exec to open a browser cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows).

nodes.name: Setup
nodes.summary: Exported interactive OAuth setup function that walks the user through the full authorization code flow: validates config, opens a browser, collects the redirect URL, exchanges the authorization code for tokens, and prints the resulting credentials for the user to save.

nodes.name: parser_bench_test.go
nodes.summary: Benchmark tests for the parser package covering telemetry parsing, nested telemetry parsing, interval summation (normal and large datasets), response body reading, and combined unmarshal+sum workflows.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the Go testing.B harness with b.ResetTimer to isolate setup from the benchmarked hot path.

nodes.name: types.go
nodes.summary: Defines the shared domain types used across the application, including SystemConfig (name and system ID) and APIConfig (API key, OAuth client credentials, and token fields).

nodes.name: SystemConfig
nodes.summary: Struct holding an Enphase system's display name and numeric system ID.

nodes.name: APIConfig
nodes.summary: Struct holding all Enphase API credentials: API key, OAuth client ID/secret, authorization URL, redirect URI, refresh token, and username/password.

nodes.name: urlbuilder.go
nodes.summary: Provides a single exported function for constructing Enphase Enlighten telemetry API URLs with system ID, endpoint path, API key, and Unix timestamp boundaries.

nodes.name: BuildTelemetryURL
nodes.summary: Builds a fully-formatted Enphase API telemetry URL string from a system ID, endpoint name, API key, and day start/end time boundaries converted to Unix timestamps.

nodes.name: urlbuilder_test.go
nodes.summary: Unit tests for BuildTelemetryURL verifying correct URL construction, Unix timestamp conversion, and handling of API keys containing special characters.

nodes.summary: Integration tests for ValidateMetrics exercising the full file-load-and-compare workflow, including success, tolerance boundary, outside-tolerance, missing system, date mismatch, multiple fixture files, and real-world scenario cases — skipping automatically when test-data fixtures are absent.

nodes.name: CONTEXT.md
nodes.summary: Authoritative project glossary defining domain terminology (Site, System, Interval Data, Lifetime Data, API Budget, Cache Modes, Query Modes, True-Up Period) used consistently across code, docs, and CLI flags.

nodes.name: QUICKSTART.md
nodes.summary: Getting-started guide walking users through Enphase Cloud API credential setup, OAuth flow, config file creation, and first run-once vs continuous execution.

nodes.name: README.md

nodes.name: config.yaml.example
nodes.summary: Example YAML configuration template documenting site_id, systems list (with api_key and battery flag), display options, refresh interval, and timezone settings for the monitor.

nodes.name: aggregator.go
nodes.summary: DataAggregator orchestrates fetching metrics from one or more Enphase Systems via a CloudClient factory, merging per-system results into AggregatedMetrics and computing Net Flow.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a functional CloudClient factory injected via NewDataAggregatorWithFactory to keep cloud-API dependencies swappable in tests.

nodes.name: aggregator_bench_test.go
nodes.summary: Go benchmarks measuring DataAggregator throughput for single- vs multi-System workloads and isolating Net Flow calculation cost using a stub CloudClient.

nodes.name: aggregator_test.go
nodes.summary: Unit tests for DataAggregator covering single- and multi-System aggregation, missing API config, token errors, and context cancellation using a MockCloudClient.

nodes.name: types.go
nodes.summary: Aggregator-layer data types: AggregatedMetrics (cross-System rollup), TrueUpReport / TrueUpSystemReport (per-period accounting), and SystemMetrics (single-System slice).

nodes.name: cache_check.go
nodes.summary: Inspects on-disk Cache for a given System and Query Mode, returning per-endpoint freshness so Cache Reports can show what would be served without burning API Budget.

nodes.name: client.go
nodes.summary: EnlightenCloudClient is the central Enphase Cloud API v4 wrapper: fetches Production, Consumption, Grid Import/Export, and Battery telemetry, with budget-aware cached requests, rate-limit handling, and lifetime-endpoint fallbacks.
nodes.languageNotes: Functional options pattern (WithSystemName) and tight integration with cache.makeCachedAPIRequest centralize all API Budget accounting.

nodes.name: client_functional_test.go
nodes.summary: End-to-end-style tests for EnlightenCloudClient using httptest servers to verify telemetry parsing, partial failures, consumption fallback, cache-used tracking, and URL building.

nodes.name: client_lifetime_test.go
nodes.summary: Tests Month/Year/True-Up Query Modes that exercise the energy_lifetime endpoint, including past-date cache hits, API errors, rate-limit warnings, and the no-cache fallback notice.

nodes.name: client_test.go
nodes.summary: Focused unit tests for EnlightenCloudClient covering Production fetches, rate-limit handling, CacheUsed flag propagation, and tryLoadPastDateCache edge cases.

nodes.name: interface.go
nodes.summary: Defines the CloudClient interface that DataAggregator depends on, exposing GetMetricsFromCloud plus per-endpoint accessors so production and mock clients are interchangeable.

nodes.name: preflight_test.go
nodes.summary: Validates API Budget preflight behaviour: when the budget is exhausted, requests fall back to cache or fail with rate-limit errors across Day/Month/Year/True-Up Query Modes for Current and Past Periods.

nodes.name: query_cost_test.go
nodes.summary: Verifies QueryCost calculation across Query Modes and battery flags to ensure single- and multi-System workloads fit within the Enphase API Budget.

nodes.name: types.go
nodes.summary: Defines LocalMetrics, the per-System payload returned by the cloud client containing Production, Consumption, Grid Import/Export, Battery data, and a CacheUsed flag.

nodes.name: cache_report.go
nodes.summary: Implements the `--cache-report` command that surveys each configured System's cache, prints per-endpoint freshness, and suggests the populate command to fill gaps.

nodes.name: runner.go
nodes.summary: Entry-point orchestration for Run-Once and Continuous Modes: validates config, drives DataAggregator, hands metrics to the display layer, and respects context cancellation between Refresh Intervals.

nodes.name: runner_test.go
nodes.summary: Tests Run-Once and Continuous runner flows including success, error propagation, context cancellation, and graceful shutdown using a mockCloudClient and stub display.

nodes.name: setup.go
nodes.summary: Application bootstrap helpers: OAuth adapter creation, display configuration with custom colors, mode flag parsing (--test, --no-cache, --debug), date parsing, and Validation Mode cache preflight.

nodes.name: setup_test.go
nodes.summary: Comprehensive tests for setup helpers covering date formatting per Query Mode, OAuth adapter, display setup with custom colors, mode configuration, and Validation Mode cache validation.

nodes.name: trueup.go
nodes.summary: Implements the True-Up Period command: parses the True-Up Start Date, computes the True-Up Window end, aggregates metrics across all Systems, and emits a TrueUpReport.

nodes.name: DataAggregator
nodes.summary: Holds the OAuth access-token provider and CloudClient factory used to fan out per-System metric fetches and merge them into AggregatedMetrics.

nodes.name: NewDataAggregator
nodes.summary: Constructs a DataAggregator wired to the default EnlightenCloudClient factory, accepting an access-token getter as the only runtime dependency.

nodes.name: NewDataAggregatorWithFactory
nodes.summary: Test-friendly constructor that allows callers to inject a custom CloudClient factory, enabling mocks for unit and benchmark tests.

nodes.name: GetAggregatedMetrics
nodes.summary: Iterates configured Systems, fetches LocalMetrics per System, validates API config, sums Production/Consumption/Grid/Battery values, and computes Net Flow into AggregatedMetrics.

nodes.name: AggregatedMetrics
nodes.summary: Cross-System rollup containing Production, Consumption, Grid Import/Export, Battery Charge/Discharge, State of Charge, Net Flow, and per-System breakdowns.

nodes.name: TrueUpReport
nodes.summary: Report structure summarizing a True-Up Period: window dates, totals across all Systems, and per-System TrueUpSystemReport entries.

nodes.name: TrueUpSystemReport
nodes.summary: Per-System slice of a True-Up Report carrying lifetime totals scoped to the True-Up Window.

nodes.name: SystemMetrics
nodes.summary: Per-System metrics carrier with Production, Consumption, Grid Import/Export, Battery telemetry, and a CacheUsed indicator for diagnostics.

nodes.name: EndpointStatus
nodes.summary: Captures whether a single cached endpoint is present, its age, and whether it is required for the requested Query Mode.

nodes.name: SystemCacheStatus
nodes.summary: Per-System cache status aggregating EndpointStatus entries; exposes AllRequiredPresent to detect whether a Cache Mode 'cached' run can succeed offline.

nodes.name: CheckCacheForSystem
nodes.summary: Probes the on-disk cache for each endpoint a given Query Mode requires for one System and returns a SystemCacheStatus without making any cloud calls.

nodes.name: EnlightenCloudClient
nodes.summary: Stateful wrapper for one Enphase System's API access: holds the base URL, system ID, API key, OAuth token, timezone, and human-friendly system name.

nodes.name: NewEnlightenCloudClient
nodes.summary: Constructs an EnlightenCloudClient against the default Enphase API base URL using the provided System ID, API key, OAuth token, and reporting timezone.

nodes.name: NewEnlightenCloudClientWithBaseURL
nodes.summary: Test-friendly EnlightenCloudClient constructor that accepts a custom base URL, enabling httptest-backed integration coverage.

nodes.name: fetchTelemetryData
nodes.summary: Shared low-level fetch that builds a telemetry URL for a date range and routes the request through the cached, budget-aware request layer.

nodes.name: GetEnergyImportForDate
nodes.summary: Returns Grid Import for the requested date and Query Mode, delegating to the lifetime endpoint for Month/Year/True-Up and to interval telemetry for Day.

nodes.name: GetEnergyExportForDate
nodes.summary: Returns Grid Export for the requested date and Query Mode using lifetime or interval endpoints as appropriate.

nodes.name: GetProductionForDate
nodes.summary: Returns Production for the requested date and Query Mode, switching between energy_lifetime and the production telemetry endpoint based on period.

nodes.name: GetConsumptionForDate
nodes.summary: Returns Consumption for the requested date and Query Mode with the same lifetime/interval routing logic used by Production and Grid endpoints.

nodes.name: GetBatteryDataForDate
nodes.summary: Fetches Battery Charge, Discharge, and final State of Charge for a System on a given Day, tolerating missing SOC payloads and skipping the call for non-battery Systems.

nodes.name: QueryCost
nodes.summary: Computes how many API calls a single-System query of the given Query Mode (and optional battery) will spend against the API Budget.

nodes.name: GetMetricsFromCloud
nodes.summary: Top-level per-System cloud fetch that gathers Production, Consumption, Grid Import/Export, and Battery data into a LocalMetrics struct, surfacing partial failures and CacheUsed status.

nodes.name: cacheMaxAge
nodes.summary: Returns the maximum acceptable cache age for the target date and Query Mode, applying tight bounds for the Current Period and effectively unlimited age for Past Periods.

nodes.name: tryLoadPastDateCache
nodes.summary: Attempts to satisfy a Past-Period request entirely from cache by locating any cached response whose payload still covers the requested date.

nodes.name: makeCachedAPIRequest
nodes.summary: Central cached HTTP request path: checks API Budget, consults the cache by max-age, falls back to past-date cache, honors Cache Modes (auto/cached/live), handles 429 rate limits, and records budget usage.

nodes.name: getEnergyLifetime
nodes.summary: Calls the energy_lifetime endpoint for Production, returning daily totals from the System install date up to a date computed from the Query Mode.

nodes.name: getConsumptionLifetime
nodes.summary: Calls the consumption_lifetime endpoint, returning daily Consumption totals over the lifetime range determined by the Query Mode.

nodes.name: getEnergyImportLifetime
nodes.summary: Calls the energy_lifetime endpoint scoped to Grid Import for lifetime-style Query Modes (Month, Year, True-Up).

nodes.name: getEnergyExportLifetime
nodes.summary: Calls the energy_lifetime endpoint scoped to Grid Export, mirroring the import lifetime path for Month/Year/True-Up Query Modes.

nodes.name: CloudClient
nodes.summary: Interface contract for a per-System cloud client, declaring GetMetricsFromCloud and per-metric accessors so the aggregator can swap real and mock implementations.

nodes.name: LocalMetrics
nodes.summary: Per-System payload returned by GetMetricsFromCloud containing Production, Consumption, Grid Import/Export, Battery data, and a CacheUsed flag.

nodes.name: RunCacheReport
nodes.summary: Implements the `--cache-report` command: iterates configured Systems, checks the cache for the effective date/Query Mode, and prints a diagnostic table plus suggested populate commands.

nodes.name: printCacheDiagnostic
nodes.summary: Formats and prints per-System cache statuses including endpoint presence, age, and the period being inspected.

nodes.name: populateCommand
nodes.summary: Builds the exact CLI command users should run to populate missing cache entries for a given date and Query Mode.

nodes.name: RunConfig
nodes.summary: Bundle of dependencies (DataAggregator, display, Config, timezone, Query Mode, test date) shared between RunOnce, RunContinuous, and fetchAndDisplay.

nodes.name: RunOnce
nodes.summary: Run-Once Mode entry point: performs a single aggregation + display pass and short-circuits when Validation Mode preflight detects insufficient cache.

nodes.name: RunContinuous
nodes.summary: Continuous Mode loop that calls fetchAndDisplay every Refresh Interval, exiting cleanly on context cancellation (SIGINT/SIGTERM).

nodes.name: fetchAndDisplay
nodes.summary: Single iteration helper that drives the DataAggregator and routes results to the display layer, used by both Run-Once and Continuous Modes.

nodes.name: SetupDisplay
nodes.summary: Constructs the terminal display from Config, applying custom Net Flow line colors and the reporting timezone before the runner starts.

nodes.name: ConfigureModes
nodes.summary: Resolves the Validation Mode (--test), Cache Mode (auto/cached/live via --no-cache), and debug-logging flags into the global runtime configuration.

nodes.name: ParseTestDate
nodes.summary: Parses the optional Validation Mode date string (YYYY-MM-DD) against the reporting timezone, returning a normalized time.Time or a clear error.

nodes.name: FormatDateForQueryMode
nodes.summary: Formats a date for display based on the active Query Mode (e.g., YYYY for Year, YYYY-MM for Month, YYYY-MM-DD for Day).

nodes.name: GetAggregatorTypes
nodes.summary: Derives the System configuration slice the DataAggregator needs from the parsed application Config.

nodes.name: ValidateValidationModeCache
nodes.summary: Validation Mode preflight that ensures the cache has all required endpoints for the target date before the runner makes any cloud calls.

nodes.name: RunTrueUp
nodes.summary: True-Up command entry point: parses the True-Up Start Date, derives the True-Up Window, aggregates lifetime metrics, and prints the TrueUpReport.

nodes.name: buildTrueUpReport
nodes.summary: Assembles a TrueUpReport from AggregatedMetrics and the True-Up Window bounds, including a per-System TrueUpSystemReport breakdown.

nodes.name: cache.go
nodes.summary: Implements the on-disk response cache for Enphase API calls along with global runtime state (Validation Mode, Cache Mode disable flag, debug, API Budget tracking, last-call timestamp). Provides cache key derivation, URL normalization, timezone-aware lookup, and a rolling 10-minute API call budget enforced via filesystem stamps.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses package-level sync.RWMutex to guard mutable global state; persists API call timestamps to disk for rolling-window rate limiting.

nodes.name: RedactURLKey
nodes.summary: Strips the Enphase API key query parameter from a URL so it can be safely logged or used as a cache key.

nodes.name: ResetState
nodes.summary: Clears all package-level mutable state (validation mode, cache-disabled flag, debug flag, budget warning) — used by tests to isolate runs.

nodes.name: NormalizeURLForCache
nodes.summary: Canonicalizes an Enphase API URL for cache lookup by removing the API key, sorting query parameters, and converting epoch start/end timestamps to date strings in the configured timezone.

nodes.name: extractQueriedDateFromURL
nodes.summary: Extracts the queried date from an Enphase telemetry/lifetime URL by interpreting the start_at epoch timestamp in the supplied timezone.

nodes.name: ExtractEndpointAndSystemID
nodes.summary: Parses an Enphase Systems endpoint URL to return the endpoint name (e.g., production_meter) and the System ID it targets.

nodes.name: RecordAPICall
nodes.summary: Appends the current timestamp to the persisted rolling list of API calls used to track the 10-minute API Budget.

nodes.name: RemainingBudget
nodes.summary: Returns how many API calls remain in the rolling 10-minute window relative to the configured Enphase rate limit.

nodes.name: recentAPICallStampsLocked
nodes.summary: Reads persisted API call timestamps from disk, evicts those older than the 10-minute window, and returns the recent set (mutex held by caller).

nodes.name: FindMostRecentByEndpoint
nodes.summary: Scans the cache directory for the most recent cached response matching a given endpoint and System ID, optionally bounded by a maximum age.

nodes.name: LoadCachedResponse
nodes.summary: Loads and JSON-decodes a cached HTTP response from disk for the given URL using the supplied timezone for cache key normalization.

nodes.name: SaveCachedResponseFromBytes
nodes.summary: Persists an HTTP response (status, headers, body bytes) to the cache directory under a normalized cache key derived from the URL and timezone.

nodes.name: HasCacheForDate
nodes.summary: Checks whether the cache directory already contains any cached response whose embedded query date matches the supplied target date.

nodes.name: CachedResponse
nodes.summary: Serializable struct representing a cached HTTP response (status, headers, body, metadata) with a method to reconstitute an http.Response.

nodes.name: cache_functions_test.go
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the cache package's URL normalization, key derivation, and on-disk save/load helpers, including HasCacheForDate behavior.

nodes.name: cache_test.go
nodes.summary: Tests the cache package's global state setters/getters (validation mode, cache-disabled, budget warning) and the ResetState test helper.

nodes.name: flags.go
nodes.summary: Defines the Flags struct and ParseFlags function — the single source of truth for all CLI flags including Cache Mode, Validation Mode (--test), continuous/run-once selection, and cache management commands.

nodes.name: Flags
nodes.summary: Struct holding all parsed CLI flag values (config path, continuous flag, validation flag, test date, OAuth setup, cache management toggles).

nodes.name: flags_test.go
nodes.summary: Exhaustive tests for CLI flag parsing covering defaults, single flags, cache management flags, and complex multi-flag combinations.

nodes.name: config.go
nodes.summary: Loads YAML configuration (credentials, sites, systems, refresh interval, true-up start date, color theme) and converts hex color strings to ANSI escape sequences for terminal display.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses gopkg.in/yaml.v3 with custom hex→ANSI 24-bit color conversion for both foreground and background variants.

nodes.name: MergeWithDefaults
nodes.summary: Merges a user-supplied ColorConfig with the default color theme, filling in any unspecified fields with defaults.

nodes.name: LoadConfig
nodes.summary: Reads a YAML config file from disk, applies sensible defaults for missing values, validates required fields, and converts hex color strings to ANSI codes.

nodes.name: hexToANSI
nodes.summary: Converts a #RRGGBB hex color string to an ANSI 24-bit foreground escape sequence; returns the input unchanged if it is already an ANSI code.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.summary: Top-level configuration struct combining Enphase credentials, Site/System list, refresh interval, true-up start date, and color theme.

nodes.name: ColorConfig
nodes.summary: Color theme struct with hex strings for every display element (header, production, consumption, grid import/export, net flow, etc.).

nodes.name: config_test.go
nodes.summary: Tests YAML config loading, default merging, and hex-to-ANSI color conversion across valid and invalid inputs.

nodes.name: constants.go
nodes.summary: Central registry of project-wide constants: Enphase API base URLs, cache paths, API Budget limits, Query Mode enum, default refresh interval, error sentinels, and rate-limit detection.

nodes.name: IsRateLimitError
nodes.summary: Returns true if the supplied error indicates an Enphase API rate-limit (HTTP 429 or budget-exceeded) condition.

nodes.name: constants_test.go
nodes.summary: Tests the QueryMode String() representation, IsRateLimitError detection, and the numeric values of every API/cache constant.

nodes.name: display.go
nodes.summary: Renders aggregated solar metrics and True-Up reports to the terminal with ANSI color, including per-system breakdowns, Net Flow with import/export coloring, and battery state-of-charge formatting.
nodes.languageNotes: Holds an io.Writer for testability (defaults to os.Stdout) and an explicit *time.Location for timezone-aware headers.

nodes.name: GetDefaultColors
nodes.summary: Returns the built-in default ColorConfig used when no user theme is supplied or to fill in missing fields.

nodes.name: NewDisplayWithWriter
nodes.summary: Constructs a Display configured with a specific ColorConfig, timezone, and io.Writer — used by tests to capture output.

nodes.name: ShowMetrics
nodes.summary: Top-level entry point that prints the formatted aggregated metrics report (header, combined totals, per-system breakdown).

nodes.name: printHeader
nodes.summary: Prints the report header showing the report timestamp, query date, Query Mode, and a cache-used indicator.

nodes.name: printIndividualSystems
nodes.summary: Prints a per-System breakdown with production, consumption, grid import/export, battery, and net flow when more than one System is configured.

nodes.name: printNetFlow
nodes.summary: Formats and prints the Net Flow value with import/export-specific foreground and background coloring, including the directional arrow.

nodes.name: ShowTrueUpReport
nodes.summary: Top-level entry point that prints a full True-Up Period report including header, combined section, and per-system metrics.

nodes.name: printTrueUpHeader
nodes.summary: Prints the True-Up report header containing the True-Up Start Date, current True-Up Window, and elapsed days.

nodes.name: Display
nodes.summary: Terminal output renderer bundling color theme, target timezone, and writer; exposes ShowMetrics / ShowTrueUpReport / ShowError / ShowInfo.

nodes.name: display_test.go
nodes.summary: Comprehensive tests for the terminal display covering metric rendering, cache indicators, Net Flow direction, per-system breakdowns, battery output across query modes, and True-Up reports.

nodes.name: oauth_functional_test.go
nodes.summary: Functional tests for the OAuth client covering authorization-code exchange, refresh-token and password-grant flows, token cache hit/miss behavior, and error paths (HTTP errors, invalid JSON, unauthorized).

nodes.name: parser.go
nodes.summary: Parses Enphase Enlighten API JSON responses into typed Telemetry and Lifetime structures and provides helpers to sum Interval Data values over a date range.

nodes.name: ParseNestedTelemetryResponse
nodes.summary: Parses a nested Enphase telemetry response (used by some endpoints) into a TelemetryResponseNested struct, returning the flattened interval list.

nodes.name: ParseTelemetryResponse
nodes.summary: Parses a flat Enphase telemetry response body into a TelemetryResponse struct.

nodes.name: SumIntervalValues
nodes.summary: Sums the named field (e.g., enwh, chWhDel) across a slice of TelemetryInterval entries via reflection.

nodes.name: ParseLifetimeResponse
nodes.summary: Parses an Enphase Lifetime Data response and aligns the production/consumption arrays with the daily date series.

nodes.name: SumDailyIntervals
nodes.summary: Sums production and consumption values across DailyInterval entries whose dates fall within the supplied start/end range.

nodes.name: TelemetryInterval
nodes.summary: Struct for a single Enphase telemetry interval including timestamp, production/consumption energy, grid import/export, and battery charge/discharge fields.

nodes.name: LifetimeResponse
nodes.summary: Struct mapping the Enphase Lifetime Data API response (start_date, production array, consumption array, metadata).

nodes.name: DailyInterval
nodes.summary: Struct representing one day of Lifetime Data with a date, production value, and consumption value.

nodes.name: parser_test.go
nodes.summary: Tests for the JSON parsers covering flat and nested telemetry responses, lifetime response alignment, daily-interval summation, and field-reflection sums.

nodes.name: timezone.go
nodes.summary: Loads IANA timezones and computes start/end boundaries for Day, Month, Year, and True-Up query modes, plus past-period detection for Current vs Past Period logic.
nodes.languageNotes: All boundaries are returned as time.Time anchored in the supplied *time.Location so downstream epoch conversions match the Site's local day.

nodes.name: LoadTimezone
nodes.summary: Loads an IANA timezone (e.g., America/Los_Angeles), falling back to UTC if the supplied string is empty or invalid.

nodes.name: GetDayBoundaries
nodes.summary: Returns the local-midnight start and end-of-day boundaries for the supplied target date in the given timezone.

nodes.name: ParseDateString
nodes.summary: Parses a user-supplied date or month/year token (YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, YYYY) and returns the parsed time along with the matching Query Mode.

nodes.name: GetMonthBoundaries
nodes.summary: Returns the first/last-day boundaries for the calendar month containing the supplied target date in the given timezone.

nodes.name: GetYearBoundaries
nodes.summary: Returns the first/last-day boundaries for the calendar year containing the supplied target date in the given timezone.

nodes.name: GetTrueUpBoundaries
nodes.summary: Returns the start and end-of-True-Up-Window boundaries given the configured True-Up Start Date in the supplied timezone.

nodes.name: GetBoundaries
nodes.summary: Dispatches to the appropriate Day/Month/Year/True-Up boundary helper based on the supplied Query Mode.

nodes.name: IsPastPeriod
nodes.summary: Returns true when the supplied target date for a given Query Mode refers to a Past Period (vs the Current Period) — driving whether cached responses can serve the query.

nodes.name: timezone_test.go
nodes.summary: Tests timezone loading, boundary computation for every Query Mode, past/current period detection, and date-string parsing edge cases.

nodes.name: validation.go
nodes.summary: Implements the Validation Mode (--test flag) by comparing aggregated metrics against expected values declared in a YAML expectations file, applying tolerance, and reporting pass/fail per metric.

nodes.name: ValidateMetrics
nodes.summary: Loads the expected metrics YAML for the supplied date and validates combined and per-system production, consumption, grid, and battery values within tolerance, writing a report.

nodes.name: validateMetric
nodes.summary: Compares an expected and actual metric value within tolerance, writes a pass/fail line, and reports the percentage delta.

nodes.name: ExpectedValues
nodes.summary: Per-metric expected value with tolerance percent for fuzzy validation comparisons.

nodes.name: ExpectedMetrics
nodes.summary: Top-level expectations YAML schema combining combined-totals and per-System ExpectedValues for Validation Mode.

nodes.name: validation_test.go
nodes.summary: Tests the Validation Mode: tolerance arithmetic, exact match, missing/invalid file handling, System ID resolution, and error reporting.

nodes.name: main.go
nodes.summary: Top-level entry point that parses CLI flags, handles cache management commands and OAuth setup, loads the YAML config, and dispatches into the app runner for Run-Once Mode or Continuous Mode operation.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Application bootstrap: parses flags, branches into cache CLI commands and OAuth setup as needed, loads config, wires up the OAuth client and cache, then delegates to the app runner.

nodes.name: printDebugStartup
nodes.summary: Emits a debug-mode startup banner showing configured timezone, query date, Query Mode, cache directory, and other diagnostic info.

layers.name: Application Entry & Orchestration
layers.description: Binary entry point (main.go) and the internal/app orchestrator that wires CLI flags, config, OAuth, API client, cache, aggregator, validation, and display into the end-to-end Run/TrueUp/CacheReport flows.

layers.name: CLI Interface
layers.description: Command-line flag definition and parsing (internal/cli/flags.go) plus cache-management subcommands that the runner dispatches to before the main monitoring loop.

layers.name: Enphase API Client
layers.description: HTTP client for the Enphase Enlighten Cloud API v4, including the EnphaseAPI interface, request/response types, cache-aware fetch wrapper, and the functional/preflight/query-cost/lifetime test suite.

layers.name: Metric Aggregator
layers.description: Multi-system metric aggregation that sums production, consumption, battery, grid import/export, and net-flow values across all Enphase Systems belonging to a Site, plus the aggregator-specific result types and benchmarks.

layers.name: Response Cache
layers.description: Filesystem-backed response cache for Enphase API calls, including the cache store implementation and the cache CLI helpers (clear/inspect) used by the cli subcommands.

layers.name: OAuth Authentication
layers.description: OAuth 2.0 token acquisition, refresh, and persistence against the Enphase identity provider, plus the interactive setup flow used on first run.

layers.name: Terminal Display
layers.description: Terminal rendering of aggregated production/consumption/battery/net-flow metrics, including formatted tables and the human-facing True-Up Period summary output.

layers.name: Foundation & Shared Utilities
layers.description: Cross-cutting building blocks consumed by every higher layer: constants, shared types, YAML config loading, timezone handling, response parser, and the URL builder for Enphase API endpoints.

layers.name: Validation & Test Fixtures
layers.description: Validation Mode logic that compares live aggregated metrics against pre-recorded expectations, together with the test-data/expected_values_*.json fixtures that drive day, month, and True-Up Period validation runs.

layers.name: Project Support & Documentation
layers.description: Repository-level documentation (README, QUICKSTART, CONTEXT), build automation (Makefile), Go module manifests, linter config, and the example app config that ship alongside the source.

tour.title: Project Overview & Domain Language
tour.description: Start with README.md to understand what enphase-monitor does — a Go CLI that aggregates solar metrics from one or more Enphase Systems at a Site via the Enlighten Cloud API v4. Then read CONTEXT.md, the authoritative project glossary that defines every domain term you'll see in the code (Site, System, Interval Data, Lifetime Data, API Budget, Cache Modes, Query Modes, True-Up Period). Treat CONTEXT.md as a dictionary — these capitalised terms appear consistently in code identifiers, CLI flags, and documentation, so internalising them up front pays back across every later step. QUICKSTART.md gives the fastest path to seeing the tool actually run end-to-end.

tour.title: Application Entry Point
tour.description: main.go is the smallest possible top-level file: parse CLI flags, branch on cache-management or OAuth-setup subcommands, otherwise load YAML config and hand off to the app runner. It owns no business logic — its only job is wiring. Reading it gives you the exact 1-2-3 shape of the program (flags → config → runner) that every subsequent step expands.
tour.languageLesson: Go's main package convention: every executable lives in package main with a func main() entry point. Go favours composition over frameworks, so main.go typically just constructs concrete types and calls them — no DI container, no annotations, just explicit wiring.

tour.title: Configuration & Domain Constants
tour.description: Before runner.go can do anything it needs two things: a typed config loaded from YAML, and a set of project-wide constants. config.go loads site_id, the list of Systems (each with api_key and a battery flag), refresh interval, timezone, and the True-Up Start Date — and converts hex color strings to ANSI escape sequences for the display layer. constants.go (the highest-fan-in node in the entire project, imported by 35 files) centralises Enphase API base URLs, the rolling API Budget limit, cache paths, the Query Mode enum, and rate-limit detection helpers. config.yaml.example shows the exact shape users must provide.
tour.languageLesson: Go's encoding/yaml uses struct tags like `yaml:"site_id"` to map YAML keys to struct fields. Constants in Go are declared with const blocks and are evaluated at compile time, which is why constants.go can safely be imported by everything else without circular-dependency risk.

tour.title: CLI Flag Parsing
tour.description: internal/cli/flags.go is the single source of truth for every flag the binary accepts: Cache Mode toggles, Validation Mode (--test), continuous vs. run-once selection, --true-up, --cache-report, --clear-cache, and friends. ParseFlags returns a Flags struct that the rest of the app reads — no global flag state leaks into other packages. cache_commands.go is the thin bridge that turns cache-related flags into calls against the cache package.
tour.languageLesson: Go's standard library flag package favours a struct-of-pointers pattern: declare your Flags struct, call flag.StringVar(&f.Field, ...) for each option, then flag.Parse(). This keeps argument parsing testable and avoids the global state that getopt-style libraries create.

tour.title: Run Modes — Runner, Cache Report, True-Up
tour.description: The app package implements the three top-level run modes that main.go dispatches into. runner.go drives Run-Once Mode and Continuous Mode: validate config, call DataAggregator on every Refresh Interval, hand results to the display, and honour context cancellation for graceful shutdown. cache_report.go implements `--cache-report`, surveying each System's on-disk cache and printing per-endpoint freshness without burning API Budget. trueup.go implements `--true-up`, parsing the True-Up Start Date, computing the True-Up Window end, and aggregating metrics across the full utility period. setup.go contains the shared bootstrap helpers (OAuth adapter, display configuration, mode flag parsing) that all three modes lean on.
tour.languageLesson: Go's context.Context is the idiomatic way to propagate cancellation and deadlines through call chains. runner.go's Continuous Mode loop selects on ctx.Done() between Refresh Intervals so SIGINT terminates the program cleanly instead of mid-fetch.

tour.title: Aggregation — Multi-System Fan-Out
tour.description: DataAggregator is the heart of the multi-system story. aggregator.go iterates over every System configured for the Site, fetches metrics in parallel via an injected CloudClient factory, merges per-system LocalMetrics into a single AggregatedMetrics struct, and computes Net Flow (production + battery discharge − consumption − battery charge − grid export). types.go defines the data structures that flow out of this layer: AggregatedMetrics (cross-System rollup), SystemMetrics (single-System slice), and TrueUpReport / TrueUpSystemReport (period accounting). The CloudClient is passed in as an interface — this dependency injection is what lets the unit tests substitute a MockCloudClient.
tour.languageLesson: Go interfaces are implemented implicitly — a type satisfies an interface just by having the right methods, no `implements` keyword required. This is how aggregator can depend on api.CloudClient without importing the concrete EnlightenCloudClient, keeping the dependency arrow pointing the right way for testability.

tour.title: Enphase API Client & Contract
tour.description: Step 6's DataAggregator depends on the CloudClient interface defined in interface.go — this is the seam that production code and mocks both implement. client.go provides EnlightenCloudClient, the production implementation: it fetches Production, Consumption, Grid Import/Export, and Battery telemetry from the Enphase Enlighten Cloud API v4, with budget-aware cached requests, rate-limit handling, and lifetime-endpoint fallbacks for Month/Year/True-Up Query Modes. types.go defines LocalMetrics, the per-System payload returned to the aggregator. cache_check.go inspects on-disk cache state without calling the API — this is what powers `--cache-report`.
tour.languageLesson: Go's net/http client is used directly here — no third-party HTTP framework. Error wrapping with fmt.Errorf("...: %w", err) preserves the original error in the chain so callers can use errors.Is and errors.As to test for specific failure modes like rate-limit errors.

tour.title: Response Cache & API Budget
tour.description: The Enphase API enforces a sliding 10-minute API Budget, so every live call has to be conserved. cache.go implements both halves of the answer: an on-disk JSON response cache keyed by System + Query Mode + date, and the global API Budget tracker that records each call's timestamp on the filesystem and refuses new calls when the rolling window is full. It also owns the global runtime state for Validation Mode, Cache Mode disable, and debug logging. cli.go provides the user-facing operations the cache subcommands (Step 4) call into: ClearTodayCache, ClearAllCache, ListCacheEntries, and the response parser for `--cache-report` output.
tour.languageLesson: Go's standard library os and io/ioutil (now io/os) make filesystem-as-database trivial. Here the cache uses file mtime as a freshness signal and the existence of timestamped marker files to enforce the sliding API Budget — no SQLite, no Redis, just files.

tour.title: Parser & Timezone Boundaries
tour.description: client.go in Step 7 returns raw JSON from the Enphase API; two foundation utilities turn it into something the aggregator can use. parser.go knows about two telemetry response shapes (a flat list of intervals and a nested intervals-inside-meta variant) plus the lifetime response, and provides helpers to sum Interval Data over a date range. timezone.go is the second piece: it loads IANA timezones and computes the Day/Month/Year/True-Up start/end boundaries that every API call and cache key depends on. It also implements the Past vs. Current Period detection that decides whether a query can be served from cache forever or must respect the 10-minute budget.
tour.languageLesson: Go's time package is famously opinionated: time.Time carries a Location pointer, so timezone-aware arithmetic is just t.In(loc). The reference format "2006-01-02 15:04:05" (those exact numbers) is the canonical way to declare layouts for parsing and formatting — there's no strftime.

tour.title: Terminal Display
tour.description: display.go is the final destination of every Run/TrueUp/CacheReport flow. It renders AggregatedMetrics (from Step 6) to the terminal with ANSI color: per-system production/consumption breakdowns, battery state-of-charge, Net Flow with separate import/export coloring, and TrueUpReport tables. The colors themselves come from the user's config.yaml (Step 3), which converts hex strings into ANSI escape sequences — so the display layer never hard-codes a palette.
tour.languageLesson: Go has no built-in terminal styling library — ANSI escape codes are just strings prefixed with \x1b[. Keeping color values configurable through hex strings lets users override the theme without recompiling.

tour.title: OAuth Authentication
tour.description: The Enphase developer plan requires OAuth 2.0, so before any API call can succeed the user must obtain and refresh tokens. oauth.go implements the Authorization Code flow: it builds the authorization URL, exchanges the code for tokens, refreshes them on expiry, and persists them to an on-disk token cache. setup.go is the interactive wizard that main.go runs on `--oauth-setup`: it prints the URL, opens the browser, prompts for the returned code, exchanges it, and writes the credentials so subsequent runs find them automatically.
tour.languageLesson: Go's net/url and net/http packages are sufficient for full OAuth flows without external libraries. The Authorization Code flow's PKCE-free variant used here is fine for a CLI because the redirect URI is a manual copy-paste, not a webserver round-trip.

tour.title: Validation Mode & Project Support
tour.description: Validation Mode (the `--test` flag) is the regression-testing harness that ties the whole tour together: validation.go compares live AggregatedMetrics against pre-recorded expectations in test-data/expected_values_*.json, applying a tolerance and reporting pass/fail per metric. The JSON fixtures cover specific days, months, and the full year so a single run can confirm the entire pipeline (API → cache → parser → aggregator → numbers) hasn't drifted. Wrapping everything is the project-support layer: the Makefile defines the build/run/test/lint targets you use day-to-day, go.mod / go.sum lock the single yaml.v3 dependency, and .golangci.yml enforces the quality gates (errcheck, govet, staticcheck, gocognit complexity threshold) that keep the code maintainable.
tour.languageLesson: Go's testing story is built into the toolchain — `go test ./...` discovers every _test.go file, and benchmarks (file_bench_test.go) run via `go test -bench`. golangci-lint composes many individual linters into one binary; gocognit specifically targets cognitive complexity rather than cyclomatic, catching deeply-nested logic that's hard to follow even when branch counts are low.
